name: Speak with Sevren
label: Quest
description: Following the settling of Coleman Farthing's personal score at Agamand Mills, Magistrate Sevren summons the adventurer to Brill. The mills house far more…
intro: Following the settling of Coleman Farthing's personal score at Agamand Mills, Magistrate Sevren summons the adventurer to Brill. The mills house far more than bitter family ghosts; they represent an active Scourge peril on the settlement's northern border.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have given me the remains of the Agamands, and satisfied my desire for revenge. But the Agamand Mills hold a threat to all the Forsaken, not just to me.
I have spoken to Magistrate Sevren of your exploits against the Agamands, and he wishes to speak with you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Coleman speaks well of you, friend, telling of your successful forays into the Agamand Mills.
The Forsaken have need of your talents once again...

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
